items.proposed: chlorophyllin supportive; no candidate (agreed coding stands)
items.reason: Chlorophyllin is given 'for the Management of Brain Radionecrosis', a treatment complication, not the tumour; 'anti-cancer' properties are background only and PFS/OS are routine secondary outcomes with progression excluded at entry. Even if an antitumour hypothesis were read in, it is described as 'an over-the-counter drug ... and also as a food colouring agent', so R5 would require evidence of licensing as a medicine.

note: Dexamethasone (coder A only, priority 3) is not a registered intervention and not given to every patient ('combination of steroids and CHL' in Stratum A only), so per manual R9 it need not be listed.
